note: L-BFGS-B reports convergence, but at a corner of the box: all 31 parameters end within 0.5 decade of a bound (20 within 0.05), where the objective is flat. Its first line search stepped 30 in log10 space (the start's gradient norm is 4e5) and dropped the objective from 21,646 to 12,573. The gradient is exact at the start (31 of 31 agree with finite differences of PEtab's reference, max relative error 7e-8), so the optimizer's path is at fault, not the gradient. The reference solver cannot integrate this vector (stiff), so it is not rescored.
